base.policy: Original DOTA epsilon/sigma/eta/rho from configs/vit YAML

protocol.historical_exposure: V2 held-out only; all datasets were seen in historical research
protocol.label_policy: targets are read only after prediction and update; never enter adaptation

posterior.selection: Dev-5 correct strictly > Base; macro >= Base; net correction > 0

responsibility.selection: Dev-5 macro, correct, WRM, late50; R1 preferred within 0.01 pp

responsibility_full.label_policy: targets are used only by replay metrics after update; no target is passed to model

responsibility_quick.label_policy: targets are used only by replay metrics after update; no target is passed to model
